name: Primordial Jade Winged-Spear
passiveDesc: On hit, increases ATK by 3.2%/3.9%/4.6%/5.3%/6% for 6s. Max 7 stacks. This effect can only occur once every 0.3s. While in possession of the maximum possible stacks, DMG dealt is increased by 12%/15%/18%/21%/24%.

modifiers.label: DMG Bonus while at seven stacks
